items.title: Ja'Marr Chase: Held in check by Commanders
items.text:
Chase secured five of nine targets for 31 yards in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Joe Burrow: Another 300-yard effort in loss
items.text:
Burrow completed 28 of 40 passes for 300 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed twice for minus-1 yard in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.
